To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) internal attributions for negative life events are associated with less perceived disability in RA; (2) stable attributions for disease-related negative events are associated with more perceived disability over time in RA; (3) stable attributions are associated with greater disability in the absence of pain; (4) stable attributions were not associated with objective disability; and (5) the relationship between stable attributions and perceived disability was not mediated by pain.
